title: Christ Whose Glory Fills the Skies
lyrics_original: Christ, whose glory fills the skies,
Christ the true, the only Light,
Triumph o'er the shades of night;
Dayspring from on high, be near;
Dark and cheerless is the morn
Till Thy mercy's beams I see;
Glad my eyes and warm my heart.
Visit, then, this soul of mine;
Pierce the gloom of sin and grief;

bible_verses.english: But to you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness will arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.
The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
Because of the tender mercy of our God, with which the sunrise from on high will visit us, to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are the true Light and the Dayspring from on high. Rise in my heart today and scatter any shadows of fear, doubt, or discouragement. Let the warmth of Your mercy revive my spirit so that I may walk in Your joy and peace. Shine through me, Lord, that others might see Your radiant love today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Just as the morning sun banishes the shadows of night, Jesus shines His radiant light into the darkest corners of our souls. Without His presence, our days can feel hollow and joyless, no matter how bright the world around us appears. When we invite the Sun of Righteousness to awaken our hearts, His warmth transforms our routine into praise. Today, let His mercy illuminate your path and bring true joy to your morning.
